title: RunRecord
description: One executed basket-task attempt — build1-spec.md §3, §4. Feeds print cost computation; never uses list prices.

raw_response_ref.description: Pointer to the stored raw provider response, not the payload itself.

deviations.description: Every deviation a provider forced from standard execution settings — build1-spec.md §3. Empty if none.

service_tier.description: The service tier the provider's own response says served this call (e.g. "default", "priority", "standard"), copied verbatim; null when the response names none. Part of the constituent's purchase path (docs/methodology.md, rules-2026-11-20). Absent on records written before 2026-11-21: their raw response still carries it.

billed_usd.description: What the provider billed for this call, in USD, read from its own response (OpenRouter's usage.cost). The price of the call from rules-2026-11-20 onward; a list price is only a cross-check against it. Absent when the response reports no billed figure, and on records written before 2026-11-21, whose raw response still carries it.
